the actor critic based RL approach can be used to learn an energy efficient EMS for EREVs under uncertainty and can improve fuel efficiency by 21.8%.

we have demonstrated a new RL framework for energy management of an EREV for package delivery with continuous action output and actor critic structure, which is capable of learning from historical data and optimizing vehicle parameter in real time under uncertainties.
an Actor Critic based RL framework is a useful tool for improving the fuel efficiency of EREV's by optimizing RB EMS.

the following questions: 1) Can an RL algorithm be used for real time EMS for a vehicle with a RB controller? 2) Can an RL strategy be learned from historical trips and applied to unforeseen trips? 3) Can the RL framework be applied to other RB methods for EMS?
developing a novel RL framework for optimizing RB vehicle parameters in real time under the uncertainty of trip distance.
the development of a novel deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for energy management of extended range electric vehicles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper presents an RL framework that can be extended to many other RB EMS for different vehicle applications and operating conditions.
the proposed RL based EMS framework can be applied to any RB EMS with a continuous output to improve energy efficiency in real time.

the proposed actor critic based deep reinforcement learning framework is able to learn a generalized energy management strategy for an in use E-REV for delivery with a 21.8 percent average fuel efficiency improvement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this work presents the first actor critic based deep reinforcement learning framework to learn a generalized EMS for an in-use EREV under uncertainty.

we have demonstrated that the actor critic based deep reinforcement learning framework can be applied to the EMS for EREVs and other hybrid electric vehicles with rule based engine control logic and real time data.
we have developed an actor critic based deep reinforcement learning framework to optimize a rule-based parameter in the engine controller of an extended range electric vehicle.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed framework can be used to improve the energy efficiency of a real vehicle in real time under uncertain conditions.
a rule based vehicle control logic with a reinforcement learning based EMS can be used to optimize the RB vehicle control logic in real time for a given trip.
the proposed RL framework with continuous action space can learn a generalized strategy from historical data and can be used to optimize RB EMS in real time under uncertain driving conditions.
